description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade functions for the 'imx7d-pico-pi' board in an OpenWrt or similar embedded Linux build. It defines functions to check image metadata, perform upgrades, copy configuration, and prepare for upgrades, with conditional execution based on the board name.

methods.name: enable_image_metadata_check
methods.description: Enables image metadata check specifically for the 'imx7d-pico-pi' board.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the current board supports the image, currently supports 'imx7d-pico-pi'.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process for the 'imx7d-pico-pi' board.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration files during upgrade for the 'imx7d-pico-pi' board.
